theme: TP-4 tuple patterns in struct/variant fields typed
text: CHECKER (infer.rs, all engines): in a struct or Enum::Variant pattern, a tuple sub-pattern of a field whose declared type is a tuple with no generic part is bound against that declared type, so its shape and components are checked as a top-level tuple pattern's are (numeric leaves stay free). A check-clean run panic such as W::P { t: (a, b) } with b + 1 on a (i64, str) field is E0102. New refusal of a program that runs: a dead arm whose field tuple has another length (W::P { t: (a, b) } on a 3-tuple field). Plain field patterns, generic fields and unknown names or fields are unchanged. The 717 tracked .ax files check with the same exit codes as the base binary.
